title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
review: A fairly interesting premise, but it doesn't do anything unique after the time jump, and mostly just relies on mainstream horror tropes and scares. I fell asleep a bit during this, waking up during random musical stings, so if I ever write another review I hope it will be more fair and detailed. Maybe it will have a higher score. I can only review my own experience, and it was restless and exhausting!
